user.title: EVDANCE EV Charger
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant should reach your charger.

pick.title: EVDANCE — Local
pick.description: Chargers found on your MQTT broker. Pick one to add.

manual.title: EVDANCE — Local
manual.description: No charger was heard on the broker yet. Enter the serial number (on the unit, or in the EVDANCE app under About Charger). Make sure the charger is pointed at this broker first.

cloud.title: EVDANCE — Cloud (experimental)
cloud.description: Connect directly to the EVDANCE cloud broker. You need the charger's MQTT credentials (from an on-network capture of the charger's first connection). Untested against the live cloud — local mode is recommended.

abort.mqtt_required: Set up the MQTT integration first — EVDANCE local mode talks to Home Assistant through it.
